notes.title: Leaderboards should now be working for Destiny Mode!
notes.notes: Give Destiny! mode a try and see how you stack up. The person who has the highest score on Tier 1 Easy at the end of the day today gets a Steam Key for Bridge It Plus or Kingdom Elemental to give away.
